item.title: 1967 Triumph TR4A IRS at No Reserve
item.description: This 1967 Triumph TR4A IRS is powered by a 2,138cc inline-four paired with a four-speed manual transmission and is finished in Triumph Racing Green over black leather upholstery. The seller purchased the car in 2019 and subsequently maintained the engine, rebuilt the dual SU carburetors, and installed Weiand air filters, an aluminum radiator, a five-vane water pump, Crane Cams electronic ignition, and a stainless-steel exhaust system. item.title: 427-Powered, Ex-Burt Bacharach 1966 Chevrolet Corvette Convertible 6-Speed
item.description: This 1966 Chevrolet Corvette convertible was purchased by musician and composer Burt Bacharach in 2000 as a black-over-black example with a 350ci V8. The car was registered in the name of his wife, Jane, and the selling dealer tells us that it was refinished in blue under their ownership. The current owner acquired it in 2013, and subsequent work involved installing a 427ci V8 and a six-speed manual transmission as well as refinishing the body again and reupholstering the interior. item.title: 16k-Mile 1993 Ford Mustang LX 5.0 5-Speed
item.description: This 1993 Ford Mustang LX hatchback was purchased by the seller on BaT in October 2023, and it now shows just over 16k miles. It is powered by a 5.0-liter V8 paired with a five-speed manual transmission and is finished in Electric Red over black cloth upholstery. Equipment includes 16″ alloy wheels, a limited-slip differential, a rear hatch spoiler, power windows and locks, an AM/FM/cassette stereo, air conditioning, and cruise control. item.description: This 2015 Aston Martin V8 Vantage GT was initially delivered to Lake Forest Sportscars of Lake Bluff, Illinois, and it was previously sold on BaT in July 2022. item.title: 1971 Intermeccanica Italia Spyder 6-Speed
item.description: This 1971 Intermeccanica Italia is one of approximately 240 Spyders produced in Italy between 1967 and 1973. item.title: 27-Years-Owned, Non-Sunroof 1977 Porsche 930 Turbo Carrera
item.description: This 1977 Porsche 930 Turbo Carrera left the factory without a sunroof, and it was initially sold through a Raleigh, North Carolina-based dealership. It was purchased by the current owner in May 1999, and approximately 5k miles have been added in the ensuing 27 years. The car is powered by a turbocharged 3.0-liter flat-six that was rebuilt in June 2019, and the car is finished in Platinum Metallic over Cinnamon leather. item.title: 374-Mile 2023 Aston Martin DBS Coupe 770 Ultimate at No Reserve
item.description: This 2023 Aston Martin DBS is one of 300 770 Ultimate edition coupes produced and was specified with more than $160k in optional equipment, including almost $80k from the Aston Martin Q Program. Its twin-turbocharged quad-cam 5.2L V12 was rated at 759 horsepower in 770 Ultimate specification and is linked to an eight-speed automatic transaxle and a limited-slip differential. item.title: This Week’s Weird and Wonderful—March 6, 2026
item.description: "May you live in interesting times," said British statesman Joseph Chamberlain, though the saying is often attributed as an ancient Chinese curse. item.title: Speedster-Style 1931 Auburn 8-98
item.description: This 1931 Auburn 8-98 was fitted with steel boattail speedster coachwork before it was purchased by the current owner from the selling dealer in 2005. Chassis GU54004B subsequently underwent additional refurbishment work that included a repaint of the car in green with dark accents as well as a rebuild of the 268ci Lycoming straight-eight. item.description: This 2023 Dallara EXP is a track-only variant of the road-going Stradale and utilizes a carbon-fiber monocoque with revised aerodynamic bodywork finished in green with yellow accents.
